title: I-820 Southeast Connector construction
text:
The Southeast connector includes I-20, I-820 and US 287 in southeast Fort Worth. Bids for the design-build project were opened in November 2021. The low bidder was South Point Constructors with a bid of $1.59 billion for the base project and $742 million for deferred work, which was mostly I-820 north of US 287, for a total of $2.33 billion. Only the base project proceeded at the time.

In March 2023 additional funding became available and a deferred work component for I-820 between Ramey Avenue and Brentwood Stair Road was funded, increasing the total project cost to $2.1 billion. With the addition of this section of I-820, all of I-820 between I-30 and I-20 is included in the project. This is good news, because that section was in its original 2x2 configuration from its original construction in 1963.

Also see the I-20 page for construction photographs of the I-20 section of the Southeast Connector project.

These views start on I-820 just north of I-20, proceed north to Meadowbrook Drive just south of I-30, and then proceed back south to the US 287 intersection.
